reason: Send the jet into the cloud to see how the narrow stream creates a wider disturbance.
expectation: The impact will probably heat and push the cloud outward, though the exact result is uncertain.

alternatives.reason: The jet's passage through thin gas may also matter, but the cloud collision seems more directly tied to the disturbance goal.

effect: The jet has heated and fragmented the cloud; I can now follow how that disturbance spreads into surrounding gas.
reaction: The loss of the cloud's immediate star-forming potential makes the impact feel consequential.
reason: Combine the broken cloud with surrounding gas to follow the wider disturbance.
expectation: The hot fragments will likely transfer energy to the surrounding gas and spread the disturbance further.

alternatives.reason: Following the jet through thin gas also seems relevant, but the broken cloud offers a more direct continuation of the impact.

effect: The expanding cloud created a wide hot cavity, completing the disturbance goal; the remaining action follows the jet through thin gas.
reaction: The contrast between the narrow jet and the large cavity is striking.
reason: Follow the only offered combination to progress toward the remaining goal.
expectation: The jet will travel through the thin gas, perhaps producing an outward flow relevant to the cold clouds.

effect: The jet inflated a broad bubble, which can now interact with the cold clouds.
reaction: The bubble shows another way the narrow jet spreads its influence.
reason: Follow the only offered combination to see what happens to the cold clouds.
expectation: The expanding bubble will likely push some cold gas outward, though its eventual fate is uncertain.

effect: The flow carries some dense clouds outward while their interiors remain cold; their eventual fate is still open.
reaction: The cold clouds surviving inside a hot outflow are an interesting contrast.
reason: Follow the clouds to the outer reaches to see whether they remain within the galaxy.
expectation: The clouds will reach the outer galaxy, where their fate may become clearer; I don't know whether they will escape.

alternatives.reason: Mixing with thin gas could also reveal their fate, but the outer reaches seem more directly relevant to whether they are lost.

effect: The clouds did not escape; they turn back toward the centre, completing the remaining goal.
reaction: The outflow becoming a later inflow is a satisfying reversal.

mostWorthwhile.text: Following the cold clouds outward and seeing them return was most worthwhile: it connected the jet's disturbance to a longer cycle of gas.

leastWorthwhile.text: The second broadening of the jet into a bubble felt somewhat repetitive after the hot cavity, although it set up the cold-cloud path.

surprise.text: Dense cloud interiors could remain cold while being carried outward by a hot disturbance, and the clouds subsequently fell back.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though the bubble route was the only offered combination at that point, so I followed it rather than choosing between alternatives.

continue.text: Yes. The contrasting fates of the gas and the return flow make me curious about what happens next.
